entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: A land with a complex caste system that changes with the lunar year, in which the hero caste cannot be gained by heredity or money.

entities.name: Sursi
entities.description: A village where a woman must visit the land of the Mesa Pegasus before she marries.

entities.name: Mesa Pegasus
entities.description: Legendary winged creatures said to appear to pure-hearted brides, blessing their families with long life and good fortune.

entities.name: The Book of Tal
entities.description: An in-world writing that advises looking to the north for aid and comfort.

entities.name: Justina
entities.description: A savior who, as evil ones came to slay her, imbued her weapons with her own life force, fulfilling a prophecy.

entities.name: Lord of Atlantis
entities.description: A master of tactics who makes his people bold in battle merely by arriving to lead them.

entities.name: Atlantis
entities.description: A sunken land; most human scholars believe Merfolk are its survivors.

entities.name: Mahamoti Djinn
entities.description: A djinn of royal blood among the spirits of the air, a master of trickery and misdirection dangerous in gambling halls and battle.

entities.name: Institute of Arcane Study
entities.description: An institution whose members occasionally acquire a taste for worldly pleasures and seek employment.

entities.name: Cannelbrae
entities.description: Peat-filled bogs where the singer's mate met an early grave.

entities.name: Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar
entities.description: The author of The Underworld Cookbook, who writes that Gargoyles can be delicious.

entities.name: The Underworld Cookbook
entities.description: An in-world cookbook written by Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar.

entities.name: Gnerdel
entities.description: An Ogre philosopher who believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible.

entities.name: Rundvelt Goblins
entities.description: Goblins whose intricate affairs are often confused with anarchy.

entities.name: Pashalik Mons
entities.description: A goblin who with his raiders is the thunderhead that leads in the storm of Rundvelt Goblin affairs.

entities.name: Angus
entities.description: A young fighter to whom the speaker joked about fighting in the shade of arrows.

entities.name: Scryb
entities.description: Faeries whose clicking wings precede a rout of intruders.

entities.name: Norin the Wary
entities.description: A cautious person who refused a dare to touch a jade statue.

entities.name: Song of the Artificer
entities.description: An in-world song about stones connected to one another.

entities.name: Dominia
entities.description: The multiverse; Demons were created to destroy it, and Grizzlies roam it.

entities.name: Hel
entities.description: A realm containing the Great Wall, where the bones of all sinners wait for Ragnarok.

entities.name: Great Wall
entities.description: A wall in Hel of which the Wall of Bone is said to be an aspect.

entities.name: Ragnarok
entities.description: The final battle, when Hela will call forth the bones of all sinners.

entities.name: Hela
entities.description: The figure who will call forth the bones of sinners for the final battle at Ragnarok.

entities.name: Zombie Master
entities.description: A figure who controlled zombies even before his own death and is now one of them.

entities.name: Najib
entities.description: A man who retreated to his castle at El-Abar and was dead the next morning.

entities.name: El-Abar
entities.description: Site of Najib's castle, whose walls dwarven forces reduced to rubble in a night.

entities.name: Hurloon Mountains
entities.description: Home of Minotaurs known for their love of battle and their hymns to the dead.

entities.name: Ironclaw clan
entities.description: A deviously cowardly clan of Orcs produced by generations of genetic weeding.

entities.name: Shivan Dragon
entities.description: A dragon that takes particular glee in the misery of others.

entities.name: Shanodin Forest
entities.description: A forest whose Dryads are seen only when they wish to be.

entities.name: Mi'cha
entities.description: A war mammoth that flung a drunken soldier over ten meters to protect the speaker.

events.summary: As evil ones approached to slay her, Justina cast a great spell imbuing her weapons with her own life force, fulfilling the prophecy of salvation in the savior's death.
events.quote: Just as the evil ones approached to slay Justina, she cast a great spell, imbuing her weapons with her own life force.

events.summary: Young Angus is told a joke about fighting in the shade of so many arrows.
events.quote: So I says to young Angus, "Well, at least now we're fighting in the shade!"

events.summary: The Zombie Master died and became one of the zombies he controls, ensuring they will never betray him.
events.quote: now that he is one of them, nothing can make them betray him.

events.summary: Najib retreated to his castle at El-Abar and was dead by morning after dwarven forces reduced its walls to rubble.
events.quote: Foolishly, Najib retreated to his castle at El-Abar; the next morning he was dead.

events.summary: The war mammoth Mi'cha flung a drunken soldier who attacked the speaker from behind.
events.quote: His blow never landed; Mi'cha flung the brute over ten meters.
